items.title: When asked about Ariel Hukporti at media day, Adem Bona said, “That’s my guy.”
items.author: Gina Mizell
items.body_excerpt:
When asked about Ariel Hukporti at media day, Adem Bona said, “That’s my guy.” 

They’ve been opponents on their respective national teams. And on NBA rivals. 

Now, they’re vying for the Sixers’ backup center job.  

“Whoever gets in, gets in. Get the job done.”
